message.content:
You are a citation DOI resolver. For each of the following 5 real papers (taken verbatim from a thesis bibliography), confirm the DOI via web search (CrossRef/PubMed/publisher). Then, where easily found in an abstract or open-access text, capture ONE short VERBATIM quote of the specific numeric range/value the paper reports. NEVER fabricate a quote — if you cannot fetch one, set quote=null and access="metadata_only". Resolve a real DOI; if none can be confirmed, set doi=null and note it.

Use WebSearch and WebFetch tools. To load them, first call ToolSearch with query "select:WebSearch,WebFetch".

Papers:

1. key=stone2011prospect — Stone GW, Maehara A, Lansky AJ, et al., "A prospective natural-history study of coronary atherosclerosis (PROSPECT)," N Engl J Med 2011;364(3):226-235. Need: a quote about degree of stenosis / plaque burden range/threshold (e.g. plaque burden >=70%).

2. key=brosh2005 — Brosh D, Higano ST, Lennon RJ, Holmes DR Jr, Lerman A, "Effect of lesion length on fractional flow reserve in intermediate coronary lesions," Am Heart J 2005;150(2):338-343. Need: a quote about lesion length range.

3. key=wang2015ivus — Wang L, Wu Z, Yang C, Zheng J, Bach R, Muccigrosso D, Billiar K, Maehara A, Mintz GS, Tang D, "IVUS-based FSI models for human coronary plaque progression study: components, correlation and predictive analysis," Ann Biomed Eng 2015;43(1):107-121. Need: any quote about lumen axial skewness / lesion eccentricity / geometry.

4. key=schoenhagen2000 — Schoenhagen P, Ziada KM, Kapadia SR, Crowe TD, Nissen SE, Tuzcu EM, "Extent and direction of arterial remodeling in stable versus unstable coronary syndromes: an intravascular ultrasound study," Circulation 2000;101(6):598-603. Need: a quote about positive remodeling index range/value.

5. key=xing2017 — Xing L, Higuma T, Wang Z, et al., "Clinical significance of lipid-rich plaque detected by optical coherence tomography: a 4-year follow-up study," J Am Coll Cardiol 2017;69(20):2502-2513. Need: a quote about lipid arc angle range/threshold (e.g. maximum lipid arc >180 degrees).

Return a structured result for EACH paper: key | confirmed DOI (or null) | PMID if found | confirmed? (yes/no) | verbatim quote (or null) | access (full_text/abstract_only/metadata_only) | source URL you used. Be concise. Do NOT write any files.
